test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ekta invested some amount at a rate 9% per annum and earns a S.I. of ₹810 after 3 years. If the rate of interest is increased by 3%, then how much more interest (in ₹) would have Ekta earned on the same amount in the same time period?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹810

Rate (r) = 9% per annum

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

SI = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

**Calculations:**

810 = dfrac{P times 9 times 3}{100}

⇒ P = dfrac{810 times 100}{27}

⇒ P = ₹3000
